I've long been intrigued by the social constructs of minecraft servers. I always noticed that positions of power within a Minecraft server are usually granted extreme reverence and worship by the average basic user. There is a line of appreciation and respect for someone providing a service and their time to create a fun playing environment and maintain it, but the level of devotion to these individuals becomes absurd and borders on the behavior of a well established cult. I'm find it very interesting that the admin of voatcraft is already being referenced as a god, and devotion is building in the form of holy documents. I have always wondered if the devotion and irrational reverence of a server administrator was a product of his power over the users day to day experience, or the general age range of minecraft players and their experiences at that stage in their lives with authority, or if it's just simply a part of the minecraft culture that has developed over time.

Either way, there are so many fun dynamics it creates. People who are resistant to authority tend to not last very long. Authority tends to slowly become jaded and corrupt both from the incessant ass-kissing they receive and conversely the power they start to realize they have over the masses. I really enjoy watching it all. It takes a special individual to run a server and never let these elements overtake him, because in essence he is providing a large portion of his time for little in return with the exception of that power. That power becomes his only reward, and he starts to feel justified in using it at a whim, making sweeping changes that affect the players in large ways without much consultation. He feels this justification because he is bittered by the fact that his players do nothing but bitch or beg.

It's all such an interesting petri dish of digital social interaction. There are users who are helpful because they like to be, and there are users who are helpful because they want recognition from the administrators. There are people who thirst for power on the server and will do anything they can to squirm their way into the administrator's lap like a attention-starved dog... There are those that will assault the white knights just because they see lips attached to an ass and live to sever the connection. Of course most of these are outliers. The majority of players just want to build and play, and do so with other people in a fair and enjoyable environment. There are many other types of users as well, some who fall into other stereotypes and others who do not.

What kind of player are you?

I do not mean to imply that Spex is a corrupt administrator, or that anything I've outlined here is actively happening on the voatcraft server... yet. I'm just describing prior experience in other places and my interest in the dynamics of these social interactions. Please do not take personal offense at anything I said, because if you did you are misinterpreting my intentions. :) I look forward to finally getting on the server!

TL:DR This shits weird, lets be adults.
